Definition: adverb (of source) from G3813; from infancy:--of a child.
BiblicalUsage: Paidiothen means from childhood, from infancy. Jesus asks the father of the boy with the dumb spirit how long it has been since this came unto him, and he answers, Of a child.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this one word carries a father's long grief: the boy's torment began in childhood, and the father has carried it ever since.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
